triggers.name: new_object_events
triggers.title: New event
triggers.help: Triggers immediately when the select event happens in Zoom. Select the type of event to trigger off.

input.name: object
input.label: Event category
input.hint: Select any standard Zoom object. For example: meeting, webinar .

actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.help: Build your own Zoom action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized with your Zoom connection.

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

actions.name: add_group_member
actions.title: Add group members
actions.help: Adds new group members to a particular group in Zoom.

input.name: group_id
input.label: Group ID
input.hint: Provide the ID of the group to which new member should be added.

properties.name: email
properties.label: Email ID
properties.hint: Provide the email ID of the member to be added

properties.name: id
properties.label: ID
properties.hint: Provide the internal ID of the member to be added

actions.name: add_registrant
actions.title: Add registrant
actions.description: Add registrants to meeting/webinar/cloud recording in Zoom
actions.help: You may require users to register for meetings, webinars or cloud recordings in Zoom. Use this action to help your attendees register for them by adding them as registrants automatically. You may also collect their answers to registration questions in other online forms and log their answers when ad…

input.name: object
input.label: Event
input.hint: Select any standard Zoom object, For example, meeting, webinar, cloud recording .

actions.name: create_group
actions.title: Create group
actions.help: Creates a new group in Zoom with provided name.

input.name: name
input.label: Name
input.hint: Provide the name of the group to be created.

actions.name: create_user
actions.title: Create user
actions.help: Creates an user in Zoom.

input.name: action
input.label: Action type
input.hint: Specify how to create the new user. Find out the differences between the type here .

properties.name: email
properties.label: Email
properties.hint: User email address. Maximum of 128 characters.

properties.name: type
properties.label: User type
properties.hint: Select the license for this user. Can either be Basic, Licensed or On-prem .

properties.name: first_name
properties.label: First name
properties.hint: User first name. Cannot contain more than 5 Chinese words.

properties.name: last_name
properties.label: Last name
properties.hint: User last name. Cannot contain more than 5 Chinese words.

properties.name: password
properties.label: Password
properties.hint: User password. Minimum is 8 characters, maximum is 32 characters. Valid password format: Atleast one number and one characters and includes both upper and lower characters. Not include one identical c…

actions.name: delete_object
actions.title: Delete object
actions.help: First, filter by the object you want then fill up the input fields which appear based on the object you have selected. Amongst other things, you’ll be able to delete remove cloud recordings from meetings, remove meetings entirely, remove groups or remove group members.

actions.name: download_cloud_recording
actions.title: Download cloud recording
actions.help: If the meeting with cloud recordings is private or requires registration or is password protected, you need to register for a JWT app on the zoom marketplace and API token and secret should be saved in the connection. The download URL can be found in the output of a Zoom cloud recording trigger or f…

input.name: download_url
input.label: Download URL
input.hint: The download url of the file from the Zoom cloud recording.

input.name: download_token
input.label: Download token
input.hint: When receiving cloud recording completed webhooks, map the download token from the trigger event to this field. This allows Workato to download cloud recordings even if they are password protected.

actions.name: get_object
actions.title: Get object by ID
actions.help: First, filter by the object you want then fill up the input fields which appear based on the object you have selected. Amongst other things, you’ll be able to retrieve things such as past meeting details, past meeting instances, registrant details, cloud recording details, meeting transcripts and gr…

actions.name: get_registrants
actions.title: Get registrants
actions.description: Get registrants for meeting/webinar/cloud recording in Zoom
actions.help: Use this action to get the list of people who have registered for your meeting, webinar or cloud recording.

input.name: object
input.label: Event
input.hint: Select any standard Zoom object, For example, meeting, webinar, cloud recording .

actions.name: get_user
actions.title: Get user
actions.help: Get user details in Zoom.

input.name: id
input.label: User ID
input.hint: Provide user ID or email address of the user.

actions.name: get_webinar_participants
actions.title: Get webinar attendees
actions.description: Get attendees from webinar in Zoom
actions.help: Retrieve detailed report on each attendee of a webinar. This action retrieves the first 300 webinar attendees. Use next page token to retrieve more.

input.name: id
input.label: Webinar ID
input.hint: Provide webinar ID.

input.name: next_page_token
input.label: Next page token
input.hint: Returns whenever the set of available results exceeds current page size. Expiration period for this token is 15 minutes .

actions.name: get_webinar_results
actions.title: Retrieve webinar results
actions.description: Get results of Q&A/poll from webinar in Zoom
actions.help: Retrieve poll or Q&A results from webinars that have ended. You’ll be able to see results based on each attendee. Use these details to find out which webinar attendees have been most active.

input.name: id
input.label: Webinar ID
input.hint: Provide webinar ID.

actions.name: list_object
actions.title: List object
actions.help: Retrieve list of the selected objects in Zoom.

actions.name: schedule_object
actions.title: Schedule meeting or webinar
actions.help: Schedule a meeting or webinar in Zoom. First, select whether you want to create a meeting or webinar. Then fill up the input fields to schedule meetings and webinars dynamically.

input.name: object
input.label: Event
input.hint: Select any standard Zoom object, For example, meeting, webinar .

actions.name: search_object
actions.title: Search object
actions.help: First, filter by the object you want then fill up the input fields which appear based on the object you have selected. Amongst other things, you’ll be able to search for contacts in your company and cloud recordings from the past.

actions.name: search_users
actions.title: Search users
actions.help: Search user details by status and role in Zoom.

input.name: status
input.label: Status
input.hint: User status. Possible values are: active, inactive, pending .

input.name: role_id
input.label: Role ID
input.hint: Unique identifier of role.

actions.name: update_object
actions.title: Update object
actions.help: First, filter by the object you want then fill up the input fields which appear based on the object you have selected. Amongst other things, you’ll be able to update meeting timings, update cloud recordings, update group to ensure they are password protected for security.

actions.name: update_registrant_status
actions.title: Update registrant status
actions.description: Approve/Cancel/Deny registrants for webinars/meetings/cloud recordings in Zoom
actions.help: Use this action to approve, cancel or deny registrants directly from recipes. You’ll be able to specify the meeting, webinar or recording by its ID and approve, cancel or deny up to 30 registrants at a time.

input.name: object
input.label: Event
input.hint: Select any standard Zoom object, For example, meeting, webinar, cloud recording .

actions.name: update_user
actions.title: Update user
actions.help: Update user details in Zoom.

actions.name: update_user_status
actions.title: Update user status
actions.help: Activate or deactivate a Zoom user. Requires user:update:status, user:update:status:admin, or classic user:write:admin.

input.name: id
input.label: User ID
input.hint: Provide user ID or email address of the user.

input.name: action
input.label: Action
input.hint: Deactivate signs the user out of Zoom and blocks login. Activate restores access.
